name: Taser
concept: Police stun pistol for 1989 Everon: a boxy two-shot dart stun gun in the style of late-1980s police electroshock weapons. One cartridge, then reload. Downs the target without lethal damage.
prompt: 1980s police taser stun gun, handheld electroshock dart pistol. Chunky boxy body, much bulkier than a firearm: a large rectangular bright yellow cartridge block at the front with two square dart ports instead of a barrel, matte black polymer frame behind it with flat sides, short straight black pistol grip, trigger inside a square trigger guard, no slide, no hammer, no sights rail. Realistic police equipment prop, clean hard-surface industrial design, single object, no text, no logos, no hands, no stand.
texture_prompt: Bright safety-yellow moulded plastic front cartridge block, matte black fine-grain polymer frame and grip, dull steel screws and trigger, light edge wear, no text, no logos, flat neutral lighting.
